russolo.name: Russolo
russolo.note: The most relevant new lead: a high-contrast sans that combines Bodoni and Futura influences. More geometric than Domaine, with adjustable display contrast through optical size.

bodonimoda.name: Bodoni Moda
bodonimoda.note: Strong vertical contrast and fine hairlines. Its visible serifs are a departure from Domaine Sans, but the overall display treatment is worth comparing.

playfair.name: Playfair
playfair.note: This is the variable Playfair family, with weight, width, and a large optical-size range. Try a light weight and a large optical size for finer details.
